C1786.title: DISC: A Decentralized Identity System with Self-Sovereign Credential Aggregation to Counter Credential Forgery
C1786.summary: A 2025 IEEE paper introduces DISC, a decentralized identity system with self-sovereign credential aggregation, addressing credential forgery and privacy protection in decentralized identity scenarios.
